title: Anthropic Research logical source promotion
summary: This iteration promotes Anthropic Research and Engineering from collection-only inventory rows into a first-class source-first logical source under core_primary, making an important official research channel visible in the public source graph.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "Anthropic Research logical source promotion" tests/unit.test.js

node --test --test-name-pattern "Anthropic Research logical source promotion|source display contract governance|source-first IA contract|source inventory order reference|source-first IA dashboard|source inventory|source map scan index" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Promotion batches should be small enough that rank intent is reviewable.
lessons.evidence: Only `anthropic-research-engineering` was added to the executable display contract in this slice, at rank 25 between Anthropic News and Google DeepMind.
lessons.recommended_action: Continue future promotion batches in small groups tied to the order tuning review.

lessons.lesson: One reader-visible logical source may group multiple collection entries.
lessons.evidence: `content-anthropic-research` and `content-anthropic-engineering` now map to `anthropic-research-engineering`, while the full inventory still lists 154 collection entries.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep grouping official subchannels when they represent a single reader-visible source identity.

followups.action: Promote the next small batch from `docs/source-order-tuning-review.md`, starting with official lab/company subchannels or China model platform sources after user review.
